situation: A towering father stands next to his teenage son at a doorframe where height marks are pencilled.
subject: the fully grown person
brief: A tall man stands upright beside a wooden doorframe, his head level with the highest pencil mark on the wood, while a younger teenager stands beside him looking up to measure the difference. The man's broad shoulders and mature stance dominate the frame, clearly showing a fully grown person who has finished growing.
